dict.string: Landscape 360 menampilkan posisi dan arah kompas Anda di peta. Saat Anda merekam jejak, membagikan posisi dengan GPS Tracking, atau mengirim S.O.S, lokasi tetap dipakai saat layar mati. / Landscape 360 shows your position and compass direction on the map. While you record a track, share your position with GPS Tracking or send an S.O.S, it keeps using your location with the screen off.

Landscape 360 memakai lokasi saat layar mati atau saat Anda membuka aplikasi lain, hanya selama rekam jejak, GPS Tracking atau S.O.S berjalan. / Landscape 360 uses your location while the screen is off or you use other apps, only while a track recording, GPS Tracking or an S.O.S runs.

Landscape 360 memakai Face ID untuk masuk ke akun Anda tanpa mengetik password, jika Anda menyalakannya. / Landscape 360 uses Face ID to sign in to your account without typing the password, when you switch it on.

Landscape 360 memakai kamera saat Anda memotret kondisi jalur untuk postingan Community (data lokasi foto dihapus sebelum dikirim), dan saat memindai kode QR teman. / Landscape 360 uses the camera when you take a photo of the trail for a Community post (the photo's location data is removed before it is sent), and to scan a friend's QR code.

Landscape 360 membuka foto yang Anda pilih untuk postingan Community. Data lokasi foto dihapus sebelum dikirim. / Landscape 360 opens the photos you choose for a Community post. The photo's location data is removed before it is sent.
Landscape 360 menyimpan laporan survei yang Anda ekspor ke Foto saat Anda memilih Save Image. / Landscape 360 saves the survey report you export to Photos when you choose Save Image.
